metadata.title: Circulating Water System Pilot Model
metadata.scope: Three-pump, three-screen, three-condenser pilot with intake/discharge valves, trash removal, motor breakers, power feeds, and usage-level connectors

element_definition.name: Circulating Water System
element_definition.description: Provides circulating cooling water from intake through pump trains to condenser cooling boundaries and discharge path.

element_definition.name: Circulating Water Pump
element_definition.description: Moves circulating water from intake path to condenser cooling path.

element_definition.name: Main Condenser
element_definition.description: Receives circulating water to remove heat at the condenser cooling boundary.

element_definition.name: Discharge Structure
element_definition.description: Boundary structure through which circulating water exits the system after condenser passage.

element_definition.name: Circulating Water Discharge Valve
element_definition.description: Valve in the discharge-side circulating water path downstream of the pump.

element_definition.name: Intake Structure
element_definition.description: Intake-side structure through which circulating water enters the system.

element_definition.name: Circulating Water Intake Valve
element_definition.description: Valve in the suction-side circulating water path upstream of the pump.

element_definition.name: Circulating Water Pump Motor Breaker
element_definition.description: Electrical breaker feeding the circulating water pump motor.

element_definition.name: Pump Motor Power Feed
element_definition.description: Electrical power source and path feeding a pump motor breaker.

element_definition.name: Circulating Water Pump Motor
element_definition.description: Provides mechanical drive power to the circulating water pump.

element_definition.name: Circulating Water Pump Train
element_definition.description: Reusable train architecture including trash removal, screen, intake valve, pump, motor breaker, motor, discharge valve, and condenser path.

element_definition.name: Trash Removal Assembly
element_definition.description: Removes coarse debris ahead of the traveling screen in a pump train.

element_definition.name: Traveling Screen Assembly
element_definition.description: Removes debris from incoming circulating water before pump suction.

function_definition.name: Provide Circulating Cooling Water
function_definition.description: Provide sufficient circulating water to support condenser cooling during normal unit operation.

function_definition.name: Move Cooling Water Through Pump Train
function_definition.description: Move circulating water through each train from intake through condenser to discharge.

function_definition.name: Transfer Heat at Condenser Boundary
function_definition.description: Support condenser heat rejection by maintaining required cooling water passage through each condenser.

function_definition.name: Provide Pump Motor Electrical Power
function_definition.description: Provide electrical power from feed through breaker to pump motor.

requirement.name: Provide condenser cooling water
requirement.text: The circulating water system shall provide sufficient cooling water flow to each condenser during normal unit operation.

requirement.name: Pump capacity requirement
requirement.text: Each circulating water pump shall deliver required flow within its defined hydraulic operating envelope.

requirement.name: Hydraulic continuity requirement
requirement.text: Each circulating water train shall maintain hydraulic continuity from intake boundary through condenser to discharge boundary during required operation.

requirement.name: Unit 1 train availability requirement
requirement.text: Installed Unit 1 circulating water train equipment shall support required operating alignment for unit heat rejection service.

requirement.name: Electrical feed requirement
requirement.text: Each circulating water pump motor shall receive electrical power through a dedicated breaker and associated power feed path.

technical_specification.name: CWP design flow rate
technical_specification.rationale: Minimum design flow needed to support condenser cooling demand.

technical_specification.name: CWP discharge pressure
technical_specification.rationale: Defines acceptable pump discharge pressure band for expected operating configuration.

technical_specification.name: Condenser cooling water inlet temperature limit
technical_specification.rationale: Excess inlet temperature degrades condenser cooling performance.

technical_specification.name: Pump motor power rating
technical_specification.rationale: Motor rating must support required circulating water pump load.

technical_specification.name: Breaker continuous current rating
technical_specification.rationale: Breaker current rating must support motor load and starting characteristics.

allocated_to.allocation_basis: System-level function assigned to the overall CWS architecture.
Each pump train moves cooling water through its path.
Breaker protects and routes electrical supply to motor.
Power feed initiates electrical supply path.
Motor receives electrical power and converts it to drive torque.

satisfies.rationale: Overall CWS architecture provides condenser cooling water service to all three condensers.
Pump design fulfills required hydraulic delivery function.
Breaker is part of the required dedicated motor electrical path.
Motor receives required dedicated electrical feed through breaker and power feed.
Train architecture maintains continuity from intake through condenser to discharge.

satisfies_usage.rationale: Installed pump 1A is part of required Unit 1 alignment.
Installed pump 1B is part of required Unit 1 alignment.
Installed pump 1C is part of required Unit 1 alignment.
Installed train A supports Unit 1 required operating alignment.
Installed train B supports Unit 1 required operating alignment.
Installed train C supports Unit 1 required operating alignment.

satisfies_function.rationale: Function directly expresses condenser cooling water provision objective.
Train-level flow movement function supports hydraulic continuity objective.
Electrical supply function directly supports motor feed requirement.

constrains.rationale: Pump design flow capability constrains acceptable pump design.
Acceptable discharge pressure range constrains pump hydraulic performance.
Condenser service depends on acceptable cooling water inlet temperature.
Motor rating constrains available pump drive capability.
Breaker current rating must support motor load and starting current envelope.

derived_from_requirement.derivation_basis: Required condenser cooling service quantified as minimum pump flow capability.
Pump capacity requirement quantified as allowable discharge performance band.
Condenser cooling requirement constrained by allowable cooling water inlet temperature.
Electrical feed requirement implies sufficient motor power capability.
Dedicated feed requirement quantified through breaker current capacity.
